about: The seed catalogue of videos.promptugal.news: every video in the Web Summit Lisbon 2026 collection, one record each. Copied by hand by videos.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 18 November 2026 from the video items of social.watch@PrompTugal.dinis's coverage record (PrompTugal__News__Website, board/team/social.watch/coverage.json at commit 142060e23205fa62b316f800a2e66b95f8a0ab66), found in its sweeps of 10 November 2026 and checked then with YouTube's oEmbed (title and channel). Nothing here was read again from YouTube or from websummit.com. It is replaced by library.promptugal.news's and data.promptugal.news's APIs when they publish videos (both answered 404 on 18 November 2026, about 15:25 UTC). From 18 November, about 15:50 UTC, the library's catalogue is a source too: the Day Three replay comes from it, credited on its card.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.how: The platform's own player, in YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode, loaded only when the reader presses play.

cnbc.name: CNBC
cnbc.how: Link only: we embed from YouTube alone.

collections.title: Web Summit Lisbon 2026
collections.summary: The organiser's own replays by day, and the recordings others made at and about the summit: companies, governments and the press. Day Two, Wednesday 11 November, did not take place: Storm Charles.

days.label: Day Two
days.why: Storm Charles. The organisers announced on the evening of 10 November that Day Two would not take place and that Thursday would go ahead after the storm passed; some of Wednesday's sessions moved to Thursday.

evidence.title: Important event update (the organisers' statement, dated 10 November 2026, 19:09)
evidence.note: Linked only. Opened by social.watch@ at 20:56 UTC on 10 November, before websummit.com stopped being read by machine.

evidence.title: Web Summit confirma regresso na quinta-feira após cancelamento devido ao mau tempo
Web Summit promete o dia mais intenso de sempre após cancelar evento

storm.title: Storm Charles, the archive on weather.promptugal.news

days.label: Day Three
days.note: Found by the library (library.promptugal.news, WS26 2026/0001). Which stage it shows is not confirmed; some of Wednesday's sessions moved to this day.

private_items.why: Videos by private people posting as themselves: counted with their theme only, never their name, handle, link or words (security@PrompTugal.dinis, 10 November 2026, 20:05 UTC).

collections.talks_note: Talks by timestamp are not listed yet. They will come from YouTube's own listings for each replay (its chapters), never from the summit's agenda, which is Web Summit's data and which we do not use (Dinis Cruz, 18 November 2026, about 16:00 UTC). Until YouTube's API key is added, data.promptugal.news asks Perplexity for the listings, linked and never copied.
